resources.string: Native iPhone AirDrop is NOT implemented or accepted. This APK checks local constraints and hashes a user-selected local file. It never substitutes LAN or Wi-Fi Direct.
Select local file and calculate SHA-256
No local receipt. A matching hash alone does not prove AirDrop transport.

Safety: reads only this process’s capability bits and SELinux enforcement status; creates and immediately closes empty packet/netlink sockets. No binding, capture, injection, interface changes, TAP creation, root requests, unique device identifiers, router changes, or connectivity tests. File hashing is limited to 512 MiB. Cancellation invalidates results; an unresponsive document provider may delay worker shutdown.
